## Podio MCP server questions

### Does Podio have an official MCP server?

Yes. Podio publishes its MCP server itself. Its address is on Podio's own domain (mcp.podio.com). MartechDB only lists servers a vendor publishes, never community copies.

### What is the Podio MCP server URL?

The address is https://mcp.podio.com/mcp.

### Does the Podio MCP server need an API key?

No. You sign in with your Podio account (OAuth), and your AI client handles the rest.

### How do I connect Podio MCP to Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor?

In Claude, add https://mcp.podio.com/mcp as a custom connector (Customize, Connectors, Add custom connector). In ChatGPT, turn on developer mode (Settings, Apps, Advanced settings) and create an app with the same address. In Cursor, use the Add to Cursor link on MartechDB's page, or paste the JSON settings into your mcp.json. In Claude Code, run: claude mcp add --transport http podio https://mcp.podio.com/mcp

### What can the Podio MCP server do?

It offers 27 tools, including update_item, add_comment, get_item, get_items and get_app (as its documentation names them, read on 14 Nov 2026).

### Is the Podio MCP server in the official MCP Registry?

No. Podio hasn't published it to the official MCP Registry.

### Is the Podio MCP server working?

Yes. It answered our most recent check. We last checked it on 23 Nov 2026.

### What are the alternatives to Podio's MCP server?

In Project management, the most agent-friendly alternatives with an official MCP server are Breeze (100/100), Akiflow (98/100), Fibery AI (98/100), Basecamp (97/100) and Scoro (97/100). Podio scores 85/100 on the same index.
